message.reasoning_content:
Now write notes.txt with one line explaining both results (value and word count).

"两个结果分别是 44（data/a.txt 中整数之和）和 5（data/b.txt 去重后的单词个数）。"

Now verify with an independent check.

function.name: write_file
function.arguments: {"path": "out/notes.txt", "content": "数值为 44（data/a.txt 中所有整数之和），单词个数为 5（data/b.txt 去重后的单词个数）。\n"}

function.name: shell
function.arguments:
{"command": "python3 - <<'PY'
import re
a=open('data/a.txt').read()
s=sum(int(x) for x in re.findall(r'-?\d+',a))
ws=open('data/b.txt').read().split()
u=sorted(set(ws))
print("sum check:",s)
print("words check:",u,len(u))
print("sum.txt ok:",open('out/sum.txt').read().strip()==str(s))
print("words.txt ok:",open('out/words.txt').read().splitlines()==u)
PY
echo "--- bytes:"; od -c out/sum.txt | head; echo; cat out/notes.txt"}
